proof_attempt_summary: The initial selected-cost upper and balanced-cusp bracket was completed to a matched finite-tuple risk and honest-length frontier using fixed-arm moving-hinge testing priors and a standalone numerical Fejer argument. Final discovery audits passed the mathematics and claim correspondence; the cold referee graded the completed restricted-parent result subfield, below the field floor, with score ceiling 7.3. No mathematical collapse was found and no Lean formalization was attempted; the remaining limitations are scope, calibration constants and computational practicality.
tldr: The full stated uniform-stratum categorical original-record parent has a matched, evaluated minimax frontier for optimal population lower-CVaR value. Both root squared risk and finite 90\%-honest connected-interval expected length have order \(\min\{1,\sqrt{\eta(n,d)/\alpha}\}\), where the dense resolution is \(d/[n\log(\mathrm e d)]\) and the sparse resolution is the squared occupancy logarithm in \texttt{def:sharp-cost-resolution}. Explicit endpoint priors close the shrinking-tail converse, and the existing total unknown-propensity procedures attain the frontier. Consistency is equivalent to \(\eta(n,d)/\alpha\to0\).
gap: Qi--Pang--Liu establishes the marginal-CVaR policy objective, and Fan--Qi--Xu already studies inference on its optimum. The inspected optimal-value results concern fixed-complexity asymptotic inference, whereas the present question asks for evaluated finite-tuple minimax precision over unrestricted growing strata and shrinking tails. Generic CVaR concentration or inverse-tail rescaling of ordinary value bounds does not evaluate that question.
fill: The contribution is an answer-open joint frontier, supported by one selected-cost approximation certificate and original-record normalized testing experiments. Its resolution must derive \(r_R,r_L\), give finite attaining procedures and legal all-procedure converses, and settle consistency without imposing per-cell rarity or regular quantiles. The ACTG175 lower-tail treatment-welfare question supplies a concrete prospective use of the resulting benchmark.
